question.text: lectronic configuration of \(\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{II})\) is \(3 \mathrm{~d}^9\) whereas that of \(\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{I})\) is \(3 \mathrm{~d}^{10}\). Which of the following is correct?

options.text: Stability of \(\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{I})\) and \(\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{II})\) depends on nature of copper salts

solution.text: $\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{II})$ is more stable than $\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{I})$ because hydration energy of $\mathrm{Cu}^{+2}$ ion compensate $\mathrm{IE}_2$ of $\mathrm{Cu}$.
